title: Hampden P1294
memorial_details: A wooden plaque in a tree remembers the crew of 14 OTU Hampden P1294 which crashed in the adjacent field. Board is painted black with gilt lettering.
inscription: IN HONOUR OF/ (Names)/ WHO BRAVELY FOUGHT TO LAND BURNING &/ BADLY DAMAGED HAMPDEN BOMBER No P1294/ WITHOUT INJURY TO OTHERS./ THIS TREE ADDING ANOTHER OBSTACLE TO/ THE FATAL CRASH IN FIELD OPPOSITE/ KILLING ALL CREW./ OCTOBER 30TH 1941
